scope: Independent read-only source and current PUBLIC CSV/JSON review using stdlib only; no model/torch import, forward, GPU call, private utterance read, or historical mixed/test file read. Only this review JSON is newly written.

focal_loss_source_fact.fact: For non-target classes onehot*log_p is zero, so every non-target entry contributes -alpha*log_p_j; the target entry is alpha*(1-log_p_y)^gamma*(-log_p_y); the default reduction averages all N*C entries.
focal_loss_source_fact.interpretation: Observed CC conflict is relative to this original classification objective, not directly to W-F1. Confidence-conditioned decomposition is a hypothesis for a separately registered diagnostic; current data do not establish harmful CC or justify choosing a coefficient.

limitations: No independent model/gradient re-execution; gradient statistics are checked against persisted public arithmetic and audited frozen source.
No private utterance records were read by this reviewer; private/public reconciliation is delegated to the passed formal verifier.
Four large checkpoints and the large RoBERTa input were not rehashed here; passed formal verification covers these and historical preservation.
Pairs use entire finite nonzero parameter tensors on common support; differing common support and missing/zero tensors limit cross-loss scale comparisons.
Fixed class-covering length-stratified training batches, one seed, eval mode and freshly synchronized teachers do not reproduce historical online training gradients or population conflict frequency.
XP12 raw HSCL reference gradients are offline counterfactual quantities; its actual HSCL coefficients are zero.
Snapshot conflict, norm scale and binary relation labels do not establish F1 harm, pseudo-label correctness, test generalization or a unique root cause.
